signalAmbiguityReview.basis: A blind manual review of decoded source frames, independent of inference output, verified boundary colors: frame 59 green; frames 60 and 89 amber; frames 90 and 209 red; frame 210 green. No signal-state intervals were ambiguous; the red-crossing boundary judgement is documented with its event annotation.

crossingReference.annotationBasis: Manual review of decoded rendered frames before YOLO inference; no detector output or model-derived boxes were used.

events.notes: Manual visual review brackets the gold vehicle crossing between decoded frames 27 and 33 (0.900–1.100 s) using the leading-edge midpoint in the bottom-to-top direction. Both observations show green. This control is used only to check that no red event is emitted.

A blind source-only visual review brackets the axis-aligned vehicle box top-edge midpoint approaching/passing the stop-line centerline between frames 177 (5.900 s, upstream or at the line) and 179 (5.967 s, downstream); frame 178 is at/near the stripe. Both bracket frames show red. The conservative annotation midpoint is 5.9333 s; the rotated sprite makes a more exact single-frame visual judgment uncertain.

The blue car is stationary and visibly behind the stop line during [3, 7) s. This window includes amber through frame 89 and red frames 90–209; green returns at frame 210 (7 s), immediately after the stop interval ends.
